en.headline: AFCD prosecutes woman over 136 unlicensed dogs at Yuen Long shelter
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department charged a woman under the Rabies Regulation after a raid on a Yuen Long animal shelter found 136 dogs without valid licences.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said it has prosecuted a woman suspected of keeping 136 dogs without valid licences at an animal shelter in Yuen Long.

The department received a public complaint and conducted a surprise inspection of the premises, where officers found the unlicensed dogs. The case will be heard at Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts on 2 September.

Under the Rabies Regulation, every dog aged over five months must hold a valid licence, which must be renewed at least every three years. Offenders face a maximum fine of HK$10,000 upon conviction. The department reminded owners that regular rabies vaccination and licensing are both a legal duty and a public-health measure.

zh.headline: 漁護署檢控元朗收容所女子 涉無牌畜養136隻狗
zh.dek: 漁護署接市民投訴後突擊檢查元朗一間動物收容所，發現136隻懷疑未領有效牌照的狗隻，已向一名女子提出檢控。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，已根據《狂犬病規例》向一名涉嫌未領有有效牌照而畜養136隻狗隻的女子提出檢控。
署方早前接獲市民對元朗區一間動物收容所的投訴，隨即前往有關處所突擊檢查，行動中發現處所內共有136隻涉嫌未領有有效牌照的狗隻。案件將於9月2日在屯門裁判法院提堂。
根據《狂犬病規例》，所有超過五個月大的狗隻均須領有有效牌照，其後須每隔不超過三年續牌一次。違例者一經定罪，最高可被判罰款一萬元。發言人提醒狗隻畜養人須定期為狗隻接種狂犬病疫苗及領取牌照，這不僅是法定責任，亦是保障動物健康及公眾安全的重要措施。
